newsitem.title: USA: Lehman says bullish on ADT despite deal worries.
newsitem.headline: Lehman says bullish on ADT despite deal worries.

text.p: Lehman Brothers analyst Jeffrey Kessler said ADT Ltd remains his primary recommendation in the security sector despite concerns about the viability of its proposed acquisition by Republic Industries Inc.

In a note to clients issued Tuesday, Kessler said both companies want to consummate the deal and there is plenty of time for future negotiations. However, he also noted that at current prices and under the current terms, ADT would be unlikely to approve the deal.

Speculation about the prospects of the transaction, originally valued at $5 billion when it first was announced in July, has been rampant due to a steep decline in Republic shares that makes the terms less attractive to ADT.

The exchange ratio of the proposed deal was based on a price of $26 for each share of ADT. Under the agreement, ADT shareholders will receive 0.92857 shares of Republic common stock for each ADT share.

Republic last week denied a report in the New York Post that ADT was ready to call off the deal. ADT declined to comment on the article, but analysts said company executives dismissed the speculation.
"We would be aggressive buyers of ADT any time the price gets down to close to 18 or pre-Republic prices," Kessler wrote.
Shares of Republic rose 1/4 to 25-3/8. ADT stock dipped 1/8 to 19-1/8.
